    public List<SelectListItem> Types { get; set; } = new();
    
    public CreateModel(
        ILogger<CreateModel> logger,
        ICatalogService catalogService)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _catalogService = catalogService;
    }
    
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnGetAsync()
    {
        await LoadDropdownsAsync();
        return Page();
    }
    
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            await LoadDropdownsAsync();
            return Page();
        }
        
        var catalogItem = new CatalogItem
        {
            Name = Input.Name,
            Description = Input.Description,
            CatalogBrandId = Input.CatalogBrandId,
            CatalogTypeId = Input.CatalogTypeId,
            Price = Input.Price,
            AvailableStock = Input.AvailableStock,
            RestockThreshold = Input.RestockThreshold,
            MaxStockThreshold = Input.MaxStockThreshold
        };
        
        await _catalogService.CreateCatalogItemAsync(catalogItem);
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Created catalog item: {Name}", catalogItem.Name);
        
        return RedirectToPage("/Index");
    }
    
    private async Task LoadDropdownsAsync()
    {
        var brands = await _catalogService.GetCatalogBrandsAsync();
        Brands = brands.Select(b => new SelectListItem 
        { 
            Value = b.Id.ToString(), 
            Text = b.Brand 
        }).ToList();
        
        var types = await _catalogService.GetCatalogTypesAsync();
        Types = types.Select(t => new SelectListItem 
        { 
            Value = t.Id.ToString(), 
            Text = t.Type 
        }).ToList();
    }
}

**New Async Service**:
```csharp
public class CatalogService : ICatalogService
{
    private readonly CatalogDbContext _context;
    private readonly CatalogItemHiLoGenerator _indexGenerator;
    private readonly ILogger<CatalogService> _logger;

    public CatalogService(
        CatalogDbContext context,
        CatalogItemHiLoGenerator indexGenerator,
        ILogger<CatalogService> logger)
    {
        _context = context;
        _indexGenerator = indexGenerator;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>> GetCatalogItemsPaginatedAsync(
        int pageSize, 
        int pageIndex, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var totalItems = await _context.CatalogItems
                .LongCountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var itemsOnPage = await _context.CatalogItems
                .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
                .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Id)
                .Skip(pageSize * pageIndex)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Retrieved {Count} catalog items (page {PageIndex}, size {PageSize})", 
                itemsOnPage.Count, pageIndex, pageSize);

            return new PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>(
                pageIndex, pageSize, totalItems, itemsOnPage);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error retrieving paginated catalog items (page {PageIndex}, size {PageSize})", 
                pageIndex, pageSize);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<CatalogItem?> FindCatalogItemAsync(
        int id, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var item = await _context.CatalogItems
                .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
                .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ci => ci.Id == id, cancellationToken);

            if (item == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Catalog item with ID {Id} not found", id);
            }

            return item;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving catalog item with ID {Id}", id);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CatalogType>> GetCatalogTypesAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.CatalogTypes
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CatalogBrand>> GetCatalogBrandsAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.CatalogBrands
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<int> CreateCatalogItemAsync(
        CatalogItem catalogItem, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            catalogItem.Id = await _indexGenerator.GetNextSequenceValueAsync(
                _context, cancellationToken);
            
            _context.CatalogItems.Add(catalogItem);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Created catalog item: {Name} with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Name, catalogItem.Id);

            return catalogItem.Id;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error creating catalog item: {Name}", 
                catalogItem.Name);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task UpdateCatalogItemAsync(
        CatalogItem catalogItem, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            _context.Entry(catalogItem).State = EntityState.Modified;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Updated catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
        }
        catch (DbUpdateConcurrencyException ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Concurrency error updating catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error updating catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task RemoveCatalogItemAsync(
        int id, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var catalogItem = await _context.CatalogItems
                .FindAsync(new object[] { id }, cancellationToken);

            if (catalogItem == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Cannot remove catalog item with ID {Id} - not found", 
                    id);
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Catalog item with ID {id} not found");
            }

            _context.CatalogItems.Remove(catalogItem);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Removed catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error removing catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                id);
            throw;
        }
    }
}

## Key Technical Considerations

### 1. ViewState Elimination
Web Forms heavily relies on ViewState for maintaining state between postbacks. ASP.NET Core Razor Pages doesn't have ViewState. Strategies:
- **Form inputs**: Use model binding with [BindProperty]
- **Temporary data**: Use TempData for redirect scenarios
- **Session**: Use session for cross-request data (sparingly)
- **Hidden fields**: Use for specific scenarios

### 2. Postback vs Handler Methods
Web Forms uses postback events. Razor Pages uses handler methods:
- **Page_Load** → OnGet/OnGetAsync
- **Button_Click** → OnPost/OnPostAsync with named handlers
- **asp:Button OnClick="Create_Click"** → `<button type="submit" asp-page-handler="Create">`

### 3. Server Control Replacement
Common replacements:
- **asp:Label** → `<span>@Model.Property</span>` or `<label>`
- **asp:TextBox** → `<input asp-for="Property" />`
- **asp:DropDownList** → `<select asp-for="Property" asp-items="Model.Items">`
- **asp:GridView/ListView** → `@foreach` loop with HTML table or cards
- **asp:Button** → `<button type="submit">` with handler
- **asp:HyperLink** → `<a asp-page="/PageName">`
- **asp:Literal** → `@Html.Raw(Model.HtmlContent)`
- **asp:Repeater** → `@foreach` loop

### 4. Data Binding Patterns
```csharp
// Old Web Forms
productList.DataSource = items;
productList.DataBind();

// New Razor
// In PageModel
public List<CatalogItem> Items { get; set; }

// In view
@foreach (var item in Model.Items)
{
    <div>@item.Name</div>
}
```

### 5. URL Routing
```csharp
// Old Web Forms routing
routes.MapPageRoute("ProductsByPageRoute", 
    "Products/{index}/{size}", 
    "~/Default.aspx");

// New Razor Pages routing
// @page "/Products/{index:int}/{size:int}"
// Or in Program.cs with MapRazorPages()
```

### 6. Database Initialization
```csharp
// Old EF6
Database.SetInitializer<CatalogDBContext>(new CatalogDBInitializer());

// New EF Core - in Program.cs
using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<CatalogDbContext>();
    await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
    await SeedData.InitializeAsync(context);
}
```

## Common Pitfalls & Solutions

### 1. Forgetting to await async calls
```csharp
// ❌ WRONG
var items = _service.GetCatalogItemsAsync(); // Returns Task, not items!

// ✅ CORRECT
var items = await _service.GetCatalogItemsAsync();
```

### 2. Not using AsNoTracking for read-only queries
```csharp
// ❌ Less efficient
var items = await _context.CatalogItems.ToListAsync();

// ✅ Better for read-only
var items = await _context.CatalogItems.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
```

### 3. Circular dependencies in DI
```csharp
// ❌ WRONG - circular dependency
public class ServiceA
{
    public ServiceA(ServiceB serviceB) { }
}

public class ServiceB
{
    public ServiceB(ServiceA serviceA) { }
}

// ✅ CORRECT - introduce abstraction or redesign
```

### 4. Not handling null reference types properly
```csharp
// ❌ May cause warnings/errors in .NET 8
public string Name { get; set; }

// ✅ Nullable reference types enabled
public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
// or
public string? Name { get; set; }
```

public class CreateModel : PageModel
{
    private readonly ILogger<CreateModel> _logger;
    private readonly ICatalogService _catalogService;
    
    [BindProperty]
    public CatalogItemCreateViewModel Input { get; set; } = null!;
    
    public List<SelectListItem> Brands { get; set; } = new();
    public List<SelectListItem> Types { get; set; } = new();
    
    public CreateModel(
        ILogger<CreateModel> logger,
        ICatalogService catalogService)
    {
        _logger = logger;
        _catalogService = catalogService;
    }
    
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnGetAsync()
    {
        await LoadDropdownsAsync();
        return Page();
    }
    
    public async Task<IActionResult> OnPostAsync()
    {
        if (!ModelState.IsValid)
        {
            await LoadDropdownsAsync();
            return Page();
        }
        
        var catalogItem = new CatalogItem
        {
            Name = Input.Name,
            Description = Input.Description,
            CatalogBrandId = Input.CatalogBrandId,
            CatalogTypeId = Input.CatalogTypeId,
            Price = Input.Price,
            AvailableStock = Input.AvailableStock,
            RestockThreshold = Input.RestockThreshold,
            MaxStockThreshold = Input.MaxStockThreshold
        };
        
        await _catalogService.CreateCatalogItemAsync(catalogItem);
        
        _logger.LogInformation("Created catalog item: {Name}", catalogItem.Name);
        
        return RedirectToPage("/Index");
    }
    
    private async Task LoadDropdownsAsync()
    {
        var brands = await _catalogService.GetCatalogBrandsAsync();
        Brands = brands.Select(b => new SelectListItem 
        { 
            Value = b.Id.ToString(), 
            Text = b.Brand 
        }).ToList();
        
        var types = await _catalogService.GetCatalogTypesAsync();
        Types = types.Select(t => new SelectListItem 
        { 
            Value = t.Id.ToString(), 
            Text = t.Type 
        }).ToList();
    }
}

public class ApplicationModule : Module

    public ApplicationModule(bool useMockData)
    {

**New Async Service**:
```csharp
public class CatalogService : ICatalogService
{
    private readonly CatalogDbContext _context;
    private readonly CatalogItemHiLoGenerator _indexGenerator;
    private readonly ILogger<CatalogService> _logger;

    public CatalogService(
        CatalogDbContext context,
        CatalogItemHiLoGenerator indexGenerator,
        ILogger<CatalogService> logger)
    {
        _context = context;
        _indexGenerator = indexGenerator;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public async Task<PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>> GetCatalogItemsPaginatedAsync(
        int pageSize, 
        int pageIndex, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var totalItems = await _context.CatalogItems
                .LongCountAsync(cancellationToken);

            var itemsOnPage = await _context.CatalogItems
                .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
                .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Id)
                .Skip(pageSize * pageIndex)
                .Take(pageSize)
                .AsNoTracking()
                .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Retrieved {Count} catalog items (page {PageIndex}, size {PageSize})", 
                itemsOnPage.Count, pageIndex, pageSize);

            return new PaginatedItemsViewModel<CatalogItem>(
                pageIndex, pageSize, totalItems, itemsOnPage);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error retrieving paginated catalog items (page {PageIndex}, size {PageSize})", 
                pageIndex, pageSize);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<CatalogItem?> FindCatalogItemAsync(
        int id, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var item = await _context.CatalogItems
                .Include(c => c.CatalogBrand)
                .Include(c => c.CatalogType)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(ci => ci.Id == id, cancellationToken);

            if (item == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning("Catalog item with ID {Id} not found", id);
            }

            return item;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error retrieving catalog item with ID {Id}", id);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CatalogType>> GetCatalogTypesAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.CatalogTypes
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<IEnumerable<CatalogBrand>> GetCatalogBrandsAsync(
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        return await _context.CatalogBrands
            .AsNoTracking()
            .ToListAsync(cancellationToken);
    }

    public async Task<int> CreateCatalogItemAsync(
        CatalogItem catalogItem, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            catalogItem.Id = await _indexGenerator.GetNextSequenceValueAsync(
                _context, cancellationToken);
            
            _context.CatalogItems.Add(catalogItem);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Created catalog item: {Name} with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Name, catalogItem.Id);

            return catalogItem.Id;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error creating catalog item: {Name}", 
                catalogItem.Name);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task UpdateCatalogItemAsync(
        CatalogItem catalogItem, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            _context.Entry(catalogItem).State = EntityState.Modified;
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Updated catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
        }
        catch (DbUpdateConcurrencyException ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Concurrency error updating catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
            throw;
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error updating catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                catalogItem.Id);
            throw;
        }
    }

    public async Task RemoveCatalogItemAsync(
        int id, 
        CancellationToken cancellationToken = default)
    {
        try
        {
            var catalogItem = await _context.CatalogItems
                .FindAsync(new object[] { id }, cancellationToken);

            if (catalogItem == null)
            {
                _logger.LogWarning(
                    "Cannot remove catalog item with ID {Id} - not found", 
                    id);
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Catalog item with ID {id} not found");
            }

            _context.CatalogItems.Remove(catalogItem);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync(cancellationToken);

            _logger.LogInformation(
                "Removed catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                id);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, 
                "Error removing catalog item with ID {Id}", 
                id);
            throw;
        }
    }
}
```

## Key Technical Considerations

### 1. ViewState Elimination
Web Forms heavily relies on ViewState for maintaining state between postbacks. ASP.NET Core Razor Pages doesn't have ViewState. Strategies:
- **Form inputs**: Use model binding with [BindProperty]
- **Temporary data**: Use TempData for redirect scenarios
- **Session**: Use session for cross-request data (sparingly)
- **Hidden fields**: Use for specific scenarios

### 2. Postback vs Handler Methods
Web Forms uses postback events. Razor Pages uses handler methods:
- **Page_Load** → OnGet/OnGetAsync
- **Button_Click** → OnPost/OnPostAsync with named handlers
- **asp:Button OnClick="Create_Click"** → `<button type="submit" asp-page-handler="Create">`

### 3. Server Control Replacement
Common replacements:
- **asp:Label** → `<span>@Model.Property</span>` or `<label>`
- **asp:TextBox** → `<input asp-for="Property" />`
- **asp:DropDownList** → `<select asp-for="Property" asp-items="Model.Items">`
- **asp:GridView/ListView** → `@foreach` loop with HTML table or cards
- **asp:Button** → `<button type="submit">` with handler
- **asp:HyperLink** → `<a asp-page="/PageName">`
- **asp:Literal** → `@Html.Raw(Model.HtmlContent)`
- **asp:Repeater** → `@foreach` loop

### 4. Data Binding Patterns
```csharp
// Old Web Forms
productList.DataSource = items;
productList.DataBind();

// New Razor
// In PageModel
public List<CatalogItem> Items { get; set; }

// In view
@foreach (var item in Model.Items)
{
    <div>@item.Name</div>
}
```

### 5. URL Routing
```csharp
// Old Web Forms routing
routes.MapPageRoute("ProductsByPageRoute", 
    "Products/{index}/{size}", 
    "~/Default.aspx");

// New Razor Pages routing
// @page "/Products/{index:int}/{size:int}"
// Or in Program.cs with MapRazorPages()
```

### 6. Database Initialization
```csharp
// Old EF6
Database.SetInitializer<CatalogDBContext>(new CatalogDBInitializer());

// New EF Core - in Program.cs
using (var scope = app.Services.CreateScope())
{
    var context = scope.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<CatalogDbContext>();
    await context.Database.MigrateAsync();
    await SeedData.InitializeAsync(context);
}
```

## Common Pitfalls & Solutions

### 1. Forgetting to await async calls
```csharp
// ❌ WRONG
var items = _service.GetCatalogItemsAsync(); // Returns Task, not items!

// ✅ CORRECT
var items = await _service.GetCatalogItemsAsync();
```

### 2. Not using AsNoTracking for read-only queries
```csharp
// ❌ Less efficient
var items = await _context.CatalogItems.ToListAsync();

// ✅ Better for read-only
var items = await _context.CatalogItems.AsNoTracking().ToListAsync();
```

### 3. Circular dependencies in DI
```csharp
// ❌ WRONG - circular dependency
public class ServiceA
{
    public ServiceA(ServiceB serviceB) { }
}

public class ServiceB
{
    public ServiceB(ServiceA serviceA) { }
}

// ✅ CORRECT - introduce abstraction or redesign
```

### 4. Not handling null reference types properly
```csharp
// ❌ May cause warnings/errors in .NET 8
public string Name { get; set; }

// ✅ Nullable reference types enabled
public string Name { get; set; } = string.Empty;
// or
public string? Name { get; set; }
```

## Conclusion

This ASP.NET Web Forms application represents a **Complex migration** to .NET 8, requiring substantial refactoring across all layers. The migration involves:

1. **Complete UI rewrite** from Web Forms to Razor Pages
2. **Data access modernization** from EF6 to EF Core 8
3. **Logging migration** from log4net to Microsoft.Extensions.Logging
4. **Configuration migration** from Web.config to appsettings.json
5. **DI migration** from Autofac Web Forms to ASP.NET Core DI
6. **Async/await adoption** throughout the application
7. **Project structure** conversion to SDK-style

The migration should follow the phased approach outlined in the roadmap, starting with foundational changes (project structure, EF Core, logging) before tackling UI migration. Each phase should include testing to ensure functionality is maintained.

- ✅ Testable with proper DI
